description: This file defines the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for declining a job offer for a candidate within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes API documentation annotations and a method to identify the workflow state corresponding to declining an offer.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPI
classes.description: API class for handling candidate job offer decline actions within the recruitment process.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state constant corresponding to the 'decline offer' action.
